extracted.intended_audience: stakeholders interested in ECHA consultations (industry, NGOs, scientists, public authorities, and other interested parties)
extracted.subtask_description: Information page describing the types of public consultations ECHA runs and the resources available for submitting feedback on EU chemical regulatory processes. Useful for anyone preparing comments, evidence or responses to ECHA consultation exercises.

rubrics_metrics.name: Purpose of consultations
rubrics_metrics.description: ECHA organises consultations to get feedback from all interested parties and to gather the widest possible range of scientific information for the regulatory processes
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Consultations are intended to collect feedback and scientific information from all interested parties to inform regulatory decisions; submissions should therefore aim to provide relevant scientific evidence or stakeholder input.

rubrics_metrics.name: Substances of very high concern identification
rubrics_metrics.description: Substances of very high concern identification (REACH)
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Consultations are run to gather evidence and feedback relevant to identifying SVHCs under REACH (e.g., data on hazardous properties, uses, exposure).

rubrics_metrics.name: Draft recommendation for inclusion in the Authorisation List and consultation
rubrics_metrics.description: Draft recommendation for inclusion in the Authorisation List and consultation (REACH)
rubrics_metrics.guidance: ECHA publishes draft recommendations for substances proposed to be included in the Authorisation List and opens them for consultation; commenters should address the rationale for inclusion/exclusion and provide supporting evidence.

rubrics_metrics.name: Applications for authorisation
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Consultations may cover applications by companies seeking authorisation to use SVHCs; inputs can cover socio-economic factors, availability of alternatives, and risk management measures.

rubrics_metrics.name: Submitted restrictions under consideration
rubrics_metrics.guidance: ECHA consults on proposed restrictions of substances; contributions should provide scientific, technical, socio-economic or use-pattern evidence relevant to the proposed restriction.

rubrics_metrics.name: Current calls for comments and evidence
rubrics_metrics.description: Current calls for comments and evidence (REACH)
rubrics_metrics.guidance: ECHA issues calls for comments/evidence to gather data from stakeholders; responses should be timely and reference data sources, studies or monitoring information where possible.

rubrics_metrics.name: Current Testing Proposals
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Consultations on testing proposals seek input on the need, scope and methods of proposed tests; responders should address scientific justification and alternatives to testing where relevant.

rubrics_metrics.name: Harmonised classification and labelling (CLP)
rubrics_metrics.guidance: ECHA consults on proposals for harmonised classifications (CLH); comments should focus on hazard evidence, classification criteria, and supporting data.

rubrics_metrics.name: Harmonised classification and labelling targeted consultations
rubrics_metrics.description: Harmonised classification and labelling targeted consultations (CLP)
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Targeted CLH consultations solicit input from specific stakeholders or experts on classification proposals; targeted participants should provide focused evidence or technical input.

rubrics_metrics.name: Consultations on ECHA Executive Director’s requests (CLP)
rubrics_metrics.description: Consultations on ECHA Executive Director’s requests (CLP)
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Specific CLP-related consultation requests made by the Executive Director; contributions should respond to the particular questions or evidence needs raised in the request.

rubrics_metrics.name: Potential candidates for substitution and derogations conditions (BPR)
rubrics_metrics.description: Potential candidates for substitution and on derogations conditions (BPR)
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Consultations under BPR may seek input on active substances as candidates for substitution or on conditions for derogations; comments can address availability of safer alternatives and risk management.

rubrics_metrics.name: Consultations - Occupational Exposure Limits (CAD/CMRD)
rubrics_metrics.guidance: ECHA runs consultations on proposed occupational exposure limits; responses should provide scientific/epidemiological and workplace exposure evidence relevant to limit setting.

rubrics_metrics.name: Calls for evidence - Occupational Exposure Limits (CAD/CMRD)
rubrics_metrics.description: Calls for evidence - Occupational Exposure Limits (CAD/CMRD)
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Specific calls for evidence to inform OEL proposals; submissions should include data on exposures, health effects, and occupational measurement methodologies.

rubrics_metrics.name: Consultation timeframe and deadlines
rubrics_metrics.description: Each consultation has a start date and a deadline (e.g., Start date / Deadline shown for specific consultations)
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Contributions must be submitted within the published start and deadline dates; users should check the stated deadlines for each consultation and plan submissions accordingly.

rubrics_metrics.name: Support tools and guidance
rubrics_metrics.description: The Support section provides tools and practical guidance to companies which have responsibilities under the EU chemicals legislation (Guidance on REACH, Formats and templates, Publications, Webinars, Q&As, Helpdesks)
rubrics_metrics.guidance: ECHA supplies guidance documents, formats/templates and help resources that commenters and obligated entities should consult when preparing submissions to ensure proper format, required information and compliance with procedures.

rubrics_metrics.name: Search for chemicals / use of ECHA databases
rubrics_metrics.description: Search for chemicals — unique source of information on the chemicals manufactured and imported in Europe covering hazardous properties, classification and labelling, and information on how to use them safely.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Before commenting, stakeholders should consult ECHA databases (registered substances, C&L inventory, Candidate List, Authorisation List, restricted substances, PACT, CoRAP, etc.) to reference existing data, regulatory status and prior assessments.
